item.title: Driftflow 0.2.2
item.description:
Windows: the first-run setup no longer gets stuck after the speech model downloads. If the graphics card crashes or hangs while loading the model, Driftflow switches to the processor, and Quit always quits.

Windows: errors show on screen with a Copy Error button, and Settings › Models lets you choose graphics card or processor.

Windows: audio is only kept for dictations that fail (for a day), history is kept for 30 days, and Driftflow opens at login.

Windows: the installer now carries the Driftflow look.

Both apps are now released together on one page.

item.title: Driftflow 0.2.0
item.description:
The first public release of Driftflow for Mac: on-device dictation for Apple Silicon Macs (macOS 15 or later).

Hold Right ⌘ to dictate and release to insert; tap it once for hands-free. Nothing leaves your Mac.

From this version on, Driftflow updates itself.
